metadata.description: Free Claude Code skills by Ignasi. Pro versions on Agensi.

plugins.name: prompt-eval-harness
plugins.description: Build an eval suite for any system prompt, skill or agent: realistic and adversarial cases, code + LLM-judge graders, multi-model runs with cost and latency, regression checks.

plugins.name: claude-plugin-packager
plugins.description: Package skills, commands, subagents, hooks and MCP servers into a Claude Code plugin + marketplace, then validate and test-install it.

plugins.name: claude-code-hooks-builder
plugins.description: Design, write and test Claude Code hooks: auto-format and test after edits, block risky commands, inject context, desktop alerts.

plugins.name: session-handoff
plugins.description: Save goal, decisions, files, commands and next steps into a verified HANDOFF.md before context runs out, then resume cleanly.

plugins.name: terse-mode
plugins.description: Make your agent answer in a compact, high-signal style that cuts output tokens 30-75% without losing correctness.

plugins.name: anti-ai-slop-ui
plugins.description: Audit and redesign generic AI-generated interfaces into distinct, high-craft visual directions.

plugins.name: cv-tailor
plugins.description: Tailor your resume and cover letter to each job for ATS keyword match and metric-driven impact, without inventing experience.

plugins.name: cold-email-outreach
plugins.description: Plain-text B2B cold email and LinkedIn sequences that get replies, with built-in deliverability checks.
